title: A Typed Tensor Language for Shared-State Federated Computation
abstract: arXiv:2605.21103v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Shared-state federated computations combine client-local tensor computation, mergeable aggregation into shared state, and shared-only post-processing. We introduce a typed tensor language for this class of computations. Its two tensor sorts separate client-partitioned data from globally available values, and typing tracks the partitioned axis. A virtual global tensor serves as a semantic reference for centralized evaluation. We show that typed one-round programs factor through shared tensors whose shapes depend on the program but are independent of client and sample counts. The converse applies to typed-realizable factorizations: each encoder component is represented by an allowed aggregation or contraction with its valid merge, and the decoder is shared-only. translated_title: 一种用于共享状态联邦计算的类型化张量语言
translated_abstract: 共享状态联邦计算结合了客户端本地的张量计算、可合并聚合到共享状态，以及仅在共享状态上进行的后处理。我们为这类计算引入了一种类型化张量语言。该语言的两种张量类别将客户端分区的数据与全局可用的值区分开来，并且类型系统会追踪分区轴。一个虚拟全局张量作为集中式评估的语义参考。我们证明，类型化的一轮程序可以通过共享张量进行分解，这些共享张量的形状取决于程序本身，但与客户端数量和样本数量无关。逆命题适用于类型可实现的分解：每个编码器组件都由一个允许的聚合或收缩及其有效合并来表示，而解码器仅在共享状态上运行。该构造可逐轮扩展到持久状态为共享状态的程序。对于提供了客户端本地逐样本梯度表达式的损失函数，求和表示……
tldr: 提出了一种用于共享状态联邦计算的类型化张量语言，通过区分客户端分区数据与全局共享值并追踪分区轴，证明类型化一轮程序可分解为形状与客户端和样本数量无关的共享张量，且该构造可逐轮扩展到持久状态共享的程序。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a typed tensor language for shared-state federated computation that separates client-partitioned data from globally shared values, proves that typed one-round programs factor through shared tensors whose shapes are independent of client and sample counts, and extends this construction round by round to programs with shared persistent state.
